The cannon occupies x40..990, y70..440 with clean transparent margin. It is a compact toy-like magical cannon with horizontal short barrel and two small gold/wood underside support grips, rear grip centered x256,y400 and front grip centered x656,y400. Both grip centers at SAME y. The muzzle center is x960,y200. Rear butt is at x96,y250. The two grips are about 400px apart so two cream paws on a biped dog can rest over them. Avoid a long dangling pistol handle, no diagonal tilt. Cute light mint/ivory/gold fantasy weapon in smooth flat pastel game illustration. Crisp outlined art, matching the reference. Native high resolution, true transparent alpha.
